interpretation: Both Wikipedia cohorts favor official Kiwix on total PSS. No source optimization saving is established.
Do not attribute the difference between Wikipedia cohorts solely to archive size: inventory changes from two to four archives; editions and article resources differ (larger edition is nopic).
Larger archive bytes and entry counts do not directly equal resident bytes. No repeated-activity scaling or peak-memory result follows.
The test artifact retains known unresolved PDF layout differences and post-save reader recovery failure; these measurements do not certify their repair.
Larger California StreetZIM accepted cohort favors ours in all four adjacent pairs; it is a cold home-region map observation, not a repeated-activity, map-search or overall app advantage.

workspaceCleanup.scope: Seven verified generated project Cargo targets and twelve verified assistant-owned frozen temporary Cargo targets; no source, ZIMs, SDKs, APKs or benchmark evidence deleted.
workspaceCleanup.limitations: APFS cloned targets share extents; summed du counts are not independent physical allocations. Project du measurement precedes deletion of temporary targets outside the project.
